mechanics_summary: 0-Ki close-range Strike Super. The user slaps the opponent and recovers 50 Ki on use, with an additional 50 Ki when the attack hits; the move also interacts with the three Destruction's Concerto variants, changing their projectile behavior: Starfall fires a barrage, Comet launches a fast single Ki ball, and Meteor splits the ball into five smaller projectiles that travel around the opponent. Exact damage and frame data remain unresolved.
